metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Bee Branch, AR | Van Buren County
metaDescription: Own a Fayetteville Shale interest near Bee Branch, Arkansas in core Van Buren County? We evaluate legacy production and make a straightforward cash offer.
heroLead: Bee Branch sits inside core Van Buren County, where Fayetteville Shale wells generally produced at higher rates than the flank counties further east.
intro: This is a small community, but the acreage around it was squarely inside the leasing and drilling activity that defined the Fayetteville Shale's boom years. Many families here hold interests tied to wells that had real production histories, not only leases that never amounted to anything, which changes the valuation conversation compared to some of the flank areas we work in.

sections.heading: Core-play well performance near Bee Branch
paragraphs: Wells in this part of Van Buren County generally saw stronger initial production than the play's eastern edge, reflecting the thicker, more productive shale section here. Current output has declined substantially from those early rates, which is normal for a well now more than a decade past its peak.

sections.heading: Checking who operates the well today
paragraphs: Given the ownership changes that swept through the Fayetteville Shale, from Southwestern Energy to Flywheel Energy to BKV Corporation, we verify current operator and production data directly rather than assuming your last royalty statement reflects who's actually running the well now.
That verification is a standard part of any offer we make on a Bee Branch-area interest.

sections.heading: Family interests split across heirs
paragraphs: It's common for a Van Buren County mineral interest to be split among several heirs without a formal partition. We can typically confirm each person's fractional share through county records and purchase individual shares without requiring the whole family to act together.

faqs.question: Was Bee Branch part of the more productive core of the Fayetteville Shale?
faqs.answer: Yes, Van Buren County sits inside the play's structural core, which historically produced better results than eastern flank counties.

faqs.question: Our well's production has dropped a lot. Is that a sign something's wrong?
faqs.answer: No, that's the expected decline pattern for Fayetteville Shale wells, which drop off steeply after their first few years.

faqs.question: Can you buy just my portion if my siblings and I inherited the interest together?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can purchase your individual share without requiring every heir to sell at the same time.

faqs.question: Does the size of our tract near Bee Branch matter for a sale?
faqs.answer: It factors in, but decline-adjusted production and net mineral acres matter more than raw surface acreage. A small tract with a strong well can outvalue a large one with a marginal well.
